[SWS_DM_01265] Aging requires tested cycles only
⌈
If an operation cycle is restarted and DiagnosticMemoryDestination.agingRe-
quiresTestedCycle is set to True, the DM shall increment/decrement the aging
counter, if the events status has ’testNotCompletedThisOperationCycle’ bit and ’test-
FailedThisOperationCycle’ set to 0.
⌋
